description:
Modern, lightweight and multi-cluster Kubernetes GUI.

Modern, lightweight and multi-cluster Kubernetes GUI. Available on Windows, macOS and Linux.
Features:
- 💯 Connect to one or more clusters simultaneously
- ⚡️ Aggregated Log Viewer
- ⚖️ Resource Diff
- ✌️ Multi-Namespace Selector
- 💪 Human-friendly resource view
- ✍️ View & modify objects
- 🎉 Zero-config setup
- 😉 NOT another Electron app
- ✅ Works with any Kubernetes cluster: on-prem, GKE, EKS, AKS and others.
- 💻 Available on Windows, macOS and Linux
✨ New
- Files Tab: Pods, Deployments, StatefulSets, DaemonSets and ReplicaSets have a new Files tab to browse a container's files, preview text files and download files or whole folders as .tar).
- Workspaces: Save a set of contexts as a workspace and connect to all of them at once, from the context selector, the Command Palette or keyboard shortcuts. #442 #549
- Resource Lists: Added CPU and memory requests and limits columns to Pods, Deployments, StatefulSets, DaemonSets and ReplicaSets.
- Contexts: You can now upload your own image as a context's icon.
💎 Improvements
- Linux: .deb and .rpm installs now update from inside the app, like the AppImage
- Port Forwarding: The Port Forwards manager now lists the running port forwards of every context, not only the connected ones,
- Sidebar: Added VPA under Configuration
🐞 Fixes
- Node View: Pods that are Terminating are now show in the node's pod list.
- YAML Editor: Lines are no longer cramped on Linux and Windows, and on Linux a selection no longer runs past the text or hides the cursor #194
- Proxy: Fixed a bug where a NO_PROXY entry covering the kubeconfig's proxy-url made Aptakube skip the proxy and time out #592
